instruction: I have a folder named "data_export_Nov" on my desktop. Please rename it to "data_export_Dec".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming directory from 'data_export_Nov' to 'data_export_Dec'. Evaluator checks if the renamed directory exists using shell command. This variation uses monthly data export pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both conditions required for a rename operation
Command checks that destination folder 'data_export_Dec' exists: [ -d ~/Desktop/data_export_Dec ]
Command checks that source folder 'data_export_Nov' does NOT exist: [ ! -d ~/Desktop/data_export_Nov ]
Both checks are combined with && operator to ensure both conditions must be true
Uses exact_match metric correctly to compare output with expected value 'Renamed successfully\n'
Can properly distinguish between rename, copy, and create operations - only a true rename will pass both checks
Expected value is semantically correct for this verification
